text_block_list.text:
Seeing Тамамо Кросс ahead, City looks
back at
me, uncertain. I decide to give
her a nudge.
choice_data_list: Go tell her how you feel.

text_block_list.text:
Seems like you're back to normal. You
ran good
in the Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But I can't tell if ya overcame some
kinda hurdle,
or you're like this 'cause ya
just stopped carin'.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Did ya figure out the reason why ya run?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Except that... I want to. I run because I
want to. I
want to keep running and
running...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And I want to win. I don't want to lose to
anyone.
Especially you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Yup. All that's left to do is run past it all!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
